description: This Dart source file defines an API client class 'ApiClient' that facilitates RESTful HTTP interactions with a FastAPI backend. It includes methods for GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE HTTP requests, handles authentication tokens via shared preferences, and constructs request headers and URLs accordingly.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A lightweight client for making authenticated HTTP requests to a REST API, with support for token-based authentication via shared preferences.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs a complete Uri object from a base URL, a path, and optional query parameters.

methods.name: _authHeaders
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves authorization headers, including a Bearer token if available in shared preferences.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters and authentication.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the specified path, with optional JSON body and authentication.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request to the specified path, with optional JSON body and authentication.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified path with optional authentication.
